summary: A 14x14 flattop cab finished on this Josephine County ridge in 1981, partly from Waldo; by 2020 it was boarded and camera-watched, and listed as unmanned.

staffing.status: unmanned; remote camera surveillance (EVS Fire Watch)

access.note: Gravel road to a gate that was partly open in 2020, then a steep half-mile on foot. The 2026 directory lists the site as accessible to the public. The cab is boarded up; do not enter it.

visit.trail_note: Rough gravel road of about 5.5 miles to a gate, then a steep last half-mile on foot (2020 visit).

events.note: Register's Built field gives 1971. No other page read supports a 1971 date.
Construction began July 1, 1980, on a high point west of Little Grayback Peak.
Construction finished in 1981. Register and Rex's say the 14x14 cab was moved from Waldo Hill that year.
Registered on the National Historic Lookout Register, September 4, 2011.
Visit found the lookout no longer staffed, boarded up, with cameras that are part of the EVS Fire Watch system.
Listed as unmanned in the July 2026 directory of standing Oregon lookouts.

corrections.why: The 1980 district annual report and the 2020 visit account put construction on this site in 1980-81. The register's 1971 Built field is not explained by any page read, so it is kept only as a note.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and Rex's say the 14x14 cab was moved from Waldo Hill in 1981. The 1980 annual report and the 2020 visit account describe construction at this site starting in 1980 with material largely from Waldo. The story reports both.

Forest Lookouts quotes a 1980 report naming Waldo Mountain. The register, Rex's and Cheryl Hill's 2020 post name Waldo Hill, which Cheryl Hill says is south of Cave Junction and not Waldo Mountain east of Eugene.
The register gives 5,445 ft (1,660 m). Rex's and the 2026 directory give 5,149 ft. The 2020 post gives the summit at 5,438 ft. The record's elevation_m matches the register and is not changed.
Rex's says staffed every summer into the 2010s. The 2020 post says no longer staffed. The 2026 directory says Unmanned. Current status is recorded as unmanned.
The 2026 directory marks the site as accessible to the public, which it defines as legal access to the site. The 2020 visitor found a partly open gate and a steep walk. Level is set to restricted.

notes_for_editor: Brief's kind 'two_story' is not supported by the sources read: the register calls it a flattop 14x14 lookout and Cheryl Hill calls it a ground cabin; firelookout.org's list says '2-Story cab' but was not cited. Brief's height_m 4.3 has no supporting source in the pages read, so it is not in facts. Elevation in the brief matches the register. Forest Lookouts' 'Waldo Mountain' versus 'Waldo Hill' is unresolved beyond the register and Rex's agreeing on Waldo Hill. Two ODF or Forest Service pages were not checked.
